deploybot: Starting deploy to staging — env=staging, tag=release-v2.1.2, commit=abcd1234. Kickoff includes DB migration job=98765 (schema v5 -> v6). Canary=10% traffic. Notifying eng-releases. :rocket:

migrate-bot: migration job 98765 started. shards=12, strategy=concurrent_chunks, run_id=run-20260320-16:23. Shard 0/12 running, ETA ~2m.

alex.t: noted. Please pin canary to commit abcd1234 while we watch migrations. Keep me posted on any shard errors. :eyes:

jessica: fyi I'm tailing the migration logs for shard 0-6.

migrate-bot: shard 4 encountered 21 failed rows: constraint violation (users.email unique). auto-retry queued (backoff 5s).

priya: if retries > 5 for any shard, we should stop the traffic shift and evaluate rollback. I'll prepare rollback notes.

samir: can we pause the canary traffic shift while allowing migrations to finish? prefer not to rollback immediately unless stuck.

ops-oncall: pausing canary traffic shift now (pinning to 0%) per request. Migrations will keep running.

deploybot: canary traffic pinned to 0% (paused) — tag=release-v2.1.2 still staged.

migrate-bot: shard 4 retry succeeded after dedupe skip policy applied (skip_duplicate=true). progress 11/12.

jessica: log extract: ```ERROR: duplicate key value violates unique constraint "users_email_idx"
DETAIL: Key (email)=(foo@example.com) already exists
at 2026-03-20T16:23:45Z``` — we applied skip_duplicate for this run.

alex.t: good catch. priya, capture that in the release notes and the rollback runbook (how to reverse skip_duplicate if needed). If another shard fails, we'll abort and roll back to tag release-v2.1.1.

priya: adding runbook note: rollback window = 15m after final migration step if unable to resolve shard failures.

migrate-bot: migration job 98765 finished on staging. duration=4m12s, success=12/12. No remaining retries.

deploybot: migration complete on staging. Canary traffic restored to 10%. tag pinned: release-v2.1.2. Marking thread resolved for staging.

alex.t: LGTM. Will schedule prod rollout during Monday change window and reference this thread in release notes (schema bump + unique-index dedupe behavior). Thanks everyone. :thumbsup:
